season_water_entry.speaker: narrator
season_water_entry.text: The later season began with a missing line on a board. Lin noticed it while taking the ordinary dry approach to the canal commons. A map that had once shown a narrow public footpath now ended its brown stroke at a square labeled working enclosure. Beyond the board, the path still existed. Grass pressed into its edges, and someone had swept a little fallen lime from the stones. The erasure belonged to the picture before anyone had established that it belonged to the ground.

season_water_01_intro_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_002.text: Qiu Lian stood beside the board with a folded cloak over one forearm. She looked older in the morning light, which caught the lines beside her mouth before softening along her cheek. Her cinnabar robe carried a pale splash at the hem. When Lin approached, Qiu did not invoke any earlier friendship or contest. The earlier trial period had ended. This encounter could begin with a question of its own, if both women chose to remain for it.

season_water_01_intro_003.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_intro_003.text: They drew the enclosure from a work sketch, Qiu said. I watched the board go up yesterday. I asked whether the footpath had moved, and the installer said he was copying the latest sheet. She pointed to the brown line's blunt ending without touching it. Latest is an age, not an authority. I can see that quickly enough. I can't tell from this board who had permission to remove the line, or whether removing it was anybody's intention.

season_water_01_intro_004.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_intro_004.text: People may read that square as a closed gate even while the stones stay open. Lin looked toward two neighbors carrying empty baskets. They had stopped at the board and were talking in lowered voices. The actual work enclosure stood farther inland, behind its own marked barrier. Lin had no reason to cross that barrier. She also had no reason to let a copied picture quietly extend it. The question needed an owner before it needed the women to acquire another dispute.

season_water_01_intro_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_005.text: A gatekeeper named Bao came from the dry shelter with a brush and a tin of lime. He was the ordinary keeper now responsible for the working gauge, and his presence did not place the ended elective trial back in progress. He read the board, frowned, and said he had asked for a clearer drawing of a repaired storehouse corner. He had not asked for the footpath to disappear. He could explain his request; he could not settle the path's public status alone.

season_water_01_intro_006.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_intro_006.text: I can offer a room and a public record, Su Yao said when Bao sent for the steward. I cannot convert the latest sketch into a ruling. She arrived carrying a dry folder rather than the old trial bell. The twenty-four-copper trial grant is closed, including its unused return. This later work would use a separate authorized facility allocation, and participation would be voluntary. First let us find out whether anyone wants a record of the question rather than merely a prettier board.

season_water_01_intro_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_007.text: The basket carriers did. One was Jian, who held her cup inside a thick cloth; the other introduced herself as Ma, a widow who used the footpath to avoid the steep cart road. Ma shifted her basket straps between her hands while Jian waited quietly. Lin listened while Ma described carrying water with a sore ankle. A line on a map could turn an ordinary route into a daily argument. Its practical importance did not establish its legal source, but it gave the source question urgency.

season_water_01_intro_008.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_intro_008.text: I can make a corrected display by noon, Qiu said. The temptation was apparent in how smoothly she offered it. If Bao says his request was only the storehouse corner, we can put the old path line back and state that the enclosure has not been enlarged by this board. Su asked what evidence supported the old line. Qiu pointed to the stones. Su asked whether stones proved public access. Qiu's mouth tightened. They proved a used path. They did not answer the whole question.

season_water_01_intro_009.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_intro_009.text: A provisional notice might keep the board from doing more than its source permits. Lin sat on a bench before the standing conversation pulled her shoulder forward. It could say that the drawn enclosure is under clarification, and that actual barriers govern the work area. That still would not settle who may use the path. Ma asked whether clarification meant waiting outside for weeks. Lin heard the cost behind the word and declined to pretend the question could be answered by choosing a kinder label.

season_water_01_intro_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_010.text: Su showed the written facility authorization in her folder. Forty copper had been set aside by the ordinary commons meeting for the later season's public reading work: twelve for room use, eight for copies and boards, twelve for ordinary witness hours, four for cleanup, and four held to return if unused. None was a prize or a payment to Lin or Qiu. The meeting could fund observation and explanation within its own facility. It could not purchase public rights that belonged to another authority or erase private losses.

season_water_01_intro_011.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_intro_011.text: The twelve-copper room charge is paid to the facility account now. Su entered the receipt while Bao watched. The other sums remain designated until their work occurs. If you both choose to help, we will use free intervals after checking your existing calendars; no earlier promise will be moved to make this seem effortless. You may participate in a single question and stop. A season of public records must not become an unspoken demand that the same two people always supply them.

season_water_01_intro_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_012.text: Lin and Qiu checked the available afternoon against their own retained obligations before agreeing to attend. Neither described this as a new employment qualification. Lin would read and compare within ordinary limits, with her shoulder supported and no load or wet-bank work. Qiu would do the same, walking only the cleared dry approaches. Bao and the responsible crews would manage the physical enclosure. Their fifth stage, with four pairs, neither gave them public office nor made a slippery canal edge a sensible place to stand.

season_water_01_intro_013.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_intro_013.text: If this becomes another contest, I want the object of the contest stated, Qiu said. Faster restoration of a usable board might matter more to Ma today than the fullest history. A clean account of authority might matter more next week if somebody moves the barrier. I am willing to lose one question. I don't want us to choose one, then tell the public we settled both because the second would have complicated a pleasing result.

season_water_01_intro_014.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_intro_014.text: I don't want the record to become a reason for nobody to act. Lin looked at Ma's baskets. Her own preference had already begun assembling copied sketches, dates and witnesses into a reassuring pile. Ma did not need to admire that pile. She needed to know whether she could continue down the dry stones without being accused of crossing a work barrier she could not see from the map. The fuller history would have to answer for the time it asked from her.

season_water_01_intro_015.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_015.text: Bao opened the shelter's cupboard and produced two earlier sheets. One showed the old public path line clearly; another showed the repaired storehouse corner and the enclosure around its material stacks. The new board had combined them badly. The first sheet's notation cited an access agreement, but the agreement itself was not in the cupboard. Lin felt the satisfaction of finding a concrete copying mistake and checked herself. The mistake supported correcting the enclosure's shape. It did not supply the missing agreement's present scope.

season_water_01_intro_016.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_016.text: Jian offered to fetch a family notebook that mentioned the path. Ma offered to identify the stones people actually used. Bao could ask the work crew to confirm its barrier line before anyone altered the board. There was time for one first approach this afternoon, with a later room meeting already available if people chose it. Doing all three immediately would spend the neighbors' time as if voluntary offers made it infinite. Su asked the women to state what each approach would leave unanswered.

season_water_01_intro_017.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_intro_017.text: A prompt correction can separate the drawn enclosure from the actual work barrier, Qiu said. It leaves the path agreement unresolved. A source comparison can tell us what the two supplied sheets claimed and where the copying mistake entered; it leaves Ma waiting for a usable public notice until we finish. A listening walk can identify who is already avoiding the path and why. It leaves the board's exact source error and the agreement question for later. She named each loss without making any of them sound contemptible.

season_water_01_intro_018.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_intro_018.text: Whichever we choose, the crew's real barrier remains in place. Lin spoke to Ma as well as to Qiu. We will not tell anyone to cross a work enclosure because a board is wrong. We will not tell anyone that a missing copied line has itself revoked access. Su can post a limited clarification through the facility, and Bao can speak for his actual barrier. The source of the path right needs its own evidence and its own responsible decision.

season_water_01_intro_019.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_intro_019.text: A cart rolled up the steep road while Ma waited with empty baskets. Its driver asked why they were holding a meeting over a drawing when the path was plainly there. Qiu answered that he had chosen the road without needing to argue for it. Ma might need the path and have to argue every time. The driver reddened, then asked whether he could carry one basket up the hill if she decided to wait. The offer helped one trip. It did not settle the question.

season_water_01_choice.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_choice.text: Choose the first action for this afternoon, Su said. Restore a limited usable display with Bao's confirmed barrier, compare the supplied sheets before a public explanation, or listen along the dry approach to the people already changing their routes. Each can produce real work. Each leaves something the others would have supplied. I will keep the selected action and its consequence in the record, then bring everyone back to the room with the unanswered path agreement still clearly unanswered.

choices.text: Issue a prompt clarification limited to the confirmed work barrier.
Compare the supplied sheets before correcting the public drawing.
Listen to the people whose routes the drawing has already changed.

season_water_01_open_entry.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_entry.text: Lin chose the limited public display, and Qiu immediately asked Bao to mark the actual work barrier on a clean scrap. He walked its dry outer approach with the crew's foreman while the women remained at the shelter bench. When he returned, the foreman signed beside the enclosure line and said his stacked materials occupied no footpath stones. The signature established the crew's present arrangement. It did not establish every access claim surrounding it, and Qiu kept that distinction in the notice.

season_water_01_open_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_open_002.text: The drawn square is not the barrier, Qiu read aloud. The actual work enclosure follows the marked posts confirmed today by Bao and the foreman. The older path agreement is being sought; this board does not decide it. She used a thick brush because the old map's confident square could otherwise overpower a timid correction. Lin asked her to put the time and the names directly beside the new line. The public explanation would be usable now and traceable when another board appeared.

season_water_01_open_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_003.text: Su approved the limited clarification within the facility's display authority. Bao fixed it below the map without removing the map itself. The two surfaces made an awkward pair: the picture implied a wide closure while the words restricted what the picture could claim. Qiu wanted to repaint the square completely. Lin asked her to leave the supplied drawing visible until its copying error could be traced. Their compromise exposed the inconsistency instead of hiding its history, but it asked a passing reader to attend to both surfaces.

season_water_01_open_004.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_open_004.text: Read the clarification before you let the square choose your route, Lin told Ma. Then she heard the instruction's condescension and amended it. Bao can show you his actual barrier from here. The notice says what he and the foreman confirmed; it doesn't tell you what to decide about the path. Ma nodded and examined the posts beyond the board. The cart driver waited on the steep road. She chose the unblocked dry stones with her empty baskets, accepting a question the women could not settle for her.

season_water_01_open_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_005.text: For that trip, the new clarification saved Ma the climb. She passed the storehouse corner without entering the enclosure, greeted a worker, and returned with filled baskets before the cart reached the hill's bend. Qiu watched from the shelter with an unmistakable pleasure in prompt useful work. Lin shared the pleasure. They had not recovered the agreement, but a copied square had stopped presenting itself as sufficient authority to enlarge the work area. The specific benefit belonged in the record even while its limit remained unresolved.

season_water_01_open_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_006.text: Then a material clerk arrived with another copy of the working sketch. He told Ma the public board marked the path inside the enclosure. Ma pointed to the clarification. The clerk read it, frowned at the foreman's signature, and went to ask the foreman directly. The interruption lasted long enough for Ma to set down both baskets and flex her ankle. The provisional notice had helped one reader and failed to prevent another person from treating the original drawing as a complete order.

season_water_01_open_007.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_open_007.text: We corrected the display, not every copy already in circulation. Qiu sounded annoyed with herself rather than with the clerk. Lin asked the clerk how he had received his sheet. He said it came with a bundle of material lists, without a separate barrier instruction. The new fact gave their prompt approach a concrete unfinished edge. A notice at the gate could not travel backward into a stack of supplied papers. They would need source comparison or an issued clarification to the people using those copies.

season_water_01_open_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_008.text: The foreman resolved the immediate challenge by repeating his own barrier line and telling the clerk that the material list did not enlarge it. Ma continued home. Her baskets were full, and the trip had still acquired an unnecessary public argument. Lin wrote both facts. Qiu asked that the early usable display be named before the remaining confusion. Lin agreed, then asked that Ma's waiting time not be swallowed by the word resolved. A quick success could retain a cost that became visible only after the successful action.

season_water_01_open_009.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_open_009.text: The selected action produced a prompt limited clarification, Su said. The actual enclosure was confirmed through its responsible crew. Ma used the dry route once and was later challenged by an older copied square before the foreman clarified it. The missing access agreement remains missing, and the other copies remain uncorrected. I will bring those open questions to the room. Nobody should convert the avoided hill climb into proof that this notice established a permanent public right.

season_water_01_open_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_open_010.text: Qiu took the brush to Bao's wash basin, where he had authorized its cleaning, and returned it without splashing the working gauge papers. Lin stayed on the bench and read Ma's two distinct outcomes: a useful passage and an avoidable interruption. The rivalry had gained its first seasonal disagreement over success. Qiu wanted prompt usefulness seen clearly. Lin wanted the interruption seen clearly. Both were possible on the same page if neither woman made the other fact pay for being present.

season_water_01_compare_entry.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_entry.text: Lin chose the source comparison. Qiu put the clean notice scrap aside and brought the two supplied sheets to the bench where both women could see them without leaning over the canal rail. Bao identified the older path sheet and the later storehouse repair sheet from his cupboard entries. Their dates were clear. Their authority was less clear: the first cited an agreement not held here, and the second described materials and work space. Neither said that the second revoked the first.

season_water_01_compare_002.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_compare_002.text: The new board joined two separate questions as though the later sheet answered both. Lin traced the enclosure on the repair sheet with a blunt wooden pointer. She kept her hand below shoulder height. This shape concerns the storehouse stacks. The old path line concerns access beside them. We can identify the copying combination without deciding whether the old agreement still governs the path. Qiu nodded, then asked whether the pointer's careful movement would tell Ma anything usable before her baskets needed filling.

season_water_01_compare_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_003.text: Ma chose the steep road while the comparison continued. The cart driver carried one empty basket to the upper corner, then had to take his own load onward. Ma carried the other and rested beside the wall before descending toward the water point. Lin watched long enough to see the cost, then returned to the sheets. She could not make the source work happen faster by looking guilty. She could make its account honest about the trip the public board had failed to help in time.

season_water_01_compare_004.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_compare_004.text: The enclosure's gate mark proves the sheets were combined badly. Qiu showed the small gate on the repair drawing, which faced inland, beside the gate painted on the public board, which faced the path. The copied mark had been turned as the square expanded. Bao recognized the storehouse gate's actual direction immediately. Lin had been comparing line widths and dates. Qiu's quick spatial objection found the concrete copying error sooner than Lin's more elaborate arrangement of the sources had found it.

season_water_01_compare_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_005.text: They asked the board installer to return, and he came carrying a receipt for the copying work. He admitted combining the outlines because the repair sheet was newer and seemed more detailed. He had not received an instruction about public access. Su retained that explanation without calling it proof that no one had intended a closure elsewhere. It established this copying decision and its limits. A named mistake was useful; turning the copier's intent into every institution's intent would have extended the account beyond its witness.

season_water_01_compare_006.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_compare_006.text: We can issue a sourced correction now. Lin showed Qiu the paired originals and the installer’s explanation. The enclosure follows the storehouse repair sheet, whose gate points inland. The public path's omitted line comes from the older access sheet, whose agreement is still being sought. Qiu asked them to distinguish restored source notation from confirmed present right. Lin made that distinction prominently. The slower approach had produced an explanation another reader could inspect, and the public notice would finally have something firmer than their preference behind its shape.

season_water_01_compare_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_007.text: Su approved the source correction for the facility board. Bao and the foreman confirmed the present barrier line, which remained within the repaired storehouse arrangement. Qiu painted the corrected enclosure promptly. Lin kept copies of both source sheets beside the public explanation. The new board looked much more coherent than the original. Its coherence was dangerous in a different way: a reader might now mistake the restored path line for a complete verification of the missing agreement. They labeled the agreement question unresolved directly on that line.

season_water_01_compare_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_008.text: Ma returned by the dry path after receiving Bao's description of the actual enclosure. The correction helped her return trip. It did not remove the hill climb she had already made, the extra rest she had needed, or the time lost before filling her baskets. She looked at the carefully displayed sources and thanked the women without enthusiasm. Qiu thanked her for returning to tell them about the cost. Lin did not ask Ma to admire the completeness that had arrived too late for the first trip.

season_water_01_compare_009.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_compare_009.text: The selected action established a copying error through two retained sheets, a turned gate mark and the installer's explanation. Su read the account in the room's doorway. The present work barrier was confirmed before the corrected board was issued. The path agreement remains unresolved. Ma's first trip went by the steep road; her return used the dry path after clarification. Those trips are different outcomes, and the correction must not rewrite the first into a journey that never inconvenienced her.

season_water_01_compare_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_compare_010.text: Lin folded the source copies into the facility folder while Qiu took the painting brush back to Bao. Qiu had supplied the decisive gate orientation and the prompt corrected drawing. Lin had preserved the separation between sources and present authority. Their joint source work was useful, but the woman with the baskets had paid for its timing. Lin felt that cost more sharply than Qiu did. It would remain in the record so the slower method could not call itself careful simply because its final page was accurate.

season_water_01_listen_entry.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_entry.text: Lin chose the listening approach. The public board stayed as it was while Bao kept his actual barrier clear. Qiu looked at the uncorrected square for a moment, then turned toward the dry approach with Lin. They did not cross the enclosure or walk down a wet bank to make their listening seem adventurous. Su placed a bench at the shelter's ordinary threshold, and neighbors could stop there without losing their place in the path traffic. The first question was which routes the board had already changed.

season_water_01_listen_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_002.text: Ma described the steep road's loose upper stones and the point where a filled basket pulled against her sore ankle. Jian described taking a grandchild by the cart road because the square looked like a prohibition. A delivery boy said he had gone around the storehouse stacks on the inland side and been properly stopped by the work crew. These were distinct changes, not three votes proving a public right. Lin wrote them separately, resisting the temptation to make the number of complaints settle their legal source.

season_water_01_listen_003.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_listen_003.text: The board sent one person toward the actual enclosure while sending two away from the unblocked path. Qiu pointed to the delivery boy's route sketch. That is a present safety confusion we can tell Bao about without needing the whole agreement. Lin agreed. Bao posted a small arrow identifying the actual work gate and spoke to the next delivery worker himself. The chosen listening approach produced one narrow practical correction. It still left the public square and omitted path line unexplained for people who did not stop to talk.

season_water_01_listen_004.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_004.text: A laundress named Ren said she had used the dry stones for twenty years and would not let a painted square chase her uphill. Another neighbor answered that years of use could coexist with a tolerated private passage. Their disagreement sharpened the conversation. Ma asked them both to stop turning her baskets into an argument about their confidence. She wanted evidence she could use when challenged. Lin heard the request as a limit on her listening method: experience made the loss visible, but repeating experience did not itself retrieve the agreement.

season_water_01_listen_005.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_listen_005.text: I can record that the route matters and that the new drawing has changed decisions. Lin spoke to the group, not only to Ren. I can't certify its public status from use alone. We need the source cited on the older sheet. Ren looked disappointed. Jian looked relieved that a neighbor's loud certainty had not become everyone's answer. Qiu said they could seek the source while retaining the actual route changes as consequences. Neither the document nor the experiences would need to consume the other.

season_water_01_listen_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_006.text: Because the main board was still uncorrected, Ma chose the steep road for her next trip rather than begin another public disagreement beside her full baskets. No cart was available this time. Bao watched her stop at the upper wall and said the actual crew would not block the dry stones outside its enclosure. Ma answered that the crew was not the only reader of the board. Lin could see how a nominally open route could become burdensome when every user had to carry its explanation personally.

season_water_01_listen_007.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_listen_007.text: Listening has shown a loss we wouldn't see by repairing the map alone. Qiu kept her voice quiet enough that Ma did not have to hear her trip being made useful. It has also delayed a repair we could now make. Lin acknowledged both statements. Their chosen approach had produced better knowledge of the board's effects and one improved delivery arrow. It had not made the general display less misleading. Qiu's impatience referred to an actual remaining surface, and Lin could not answer it with another person’s testimony.

season_water_01_listen_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_008.text: Su ended the listening interval by reading back each household's account and asking permission to retain it in the public folder. The delivery boy agreed to a route sketch without his employer's name. Ma agreed to the trip and ankle difficulty without any claim about her private care. Ren agreed to her long use but refused to let it be labeled proof of agreement. The limits gave the stories back to their speakers. Lin kept those limits on the page rather than treating voluntary speech as unrestricted custody.

season_water_01_listen_009.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_listen_009.text: The selected action established several changed routes and one confusion at the actual work gate. Su showed Bao the delivery sketch. Bao corrected that narrow confusion with his arrow and direct explanation. The main board's copying error has not yet been sourced or corrected. Ma used the steep road again. The missing access agreement remains missing. These experiences justify seeking a timely answer; they do not by themselves supply the authority for a permanent answer.

season_water_01_listen_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_listen_010.text: Qiu looked once more at the large square before they entered the room. Lin looked at Ma's consent note. Each saw the unfinished part most natural to her method. Their seasonal rivalry had gained an uncomfortable symmetry: prompt repair could overlook the people already paying for confusion, while listening could make those losses eloquent and leave the confusing object in place. They had chosen the latter first. Its useful testimony and its delayed display would both have to survive the next meeting.

season_water_01_after_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_001.text: In the room, Su placed the first action's account beside the two sheets from Bao's cupboard. She kept its selected result intact without announcing that the other two approaches had somehow occurred as well. The neighbors arrived carrying different expectations. Ma wanted an answer useful on her next trip. Ren wanted long use respected. The installer wanted his copying mistake kept separate from an accusation that he had deliberately seized a path. None of those wishes established the missing agreement's words.

season_water_01_after_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_after_002.text: We can ask for the agreement before deciding what it must say, Qiu said. The sentence was directed partly at herself. She had been imagining a clean public-access clause that would let the next drawing restore the path without hesitation. Lin had been imagining conditions requiring a patient source record. Both imagined documents might prove convenient to their authors. Su wrote the actual request: the agreement cited on Bao's older path sheet, including its date, parties, route description and any recorded later amendment.

season_water_01_after_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_003.text: Bao identified the commons ledger holder as the person authorized to supply that copy. He did not offer to let Lin search a private cupboard merely because she was careful with papers. Su sent the written request through the facility's ordinary messenger, whose work belonged to the existing office service and was not a new charge to the forty-copper reading allocation. The copy would arrive when its custodian could verify it. Ma sighed at another wait, then asked when the room would open again.

season_water_01_after_004.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_after_004.text: The next available meeting is two days from now, Su said after checking the room calendar and the participants' remaining commitments. Attendance is optional. If the source is not ready, I will post that fact rather than call people in to hear an invented answer. She asked Ma whether the time suited her basket trips. Ma requested a later opening. The room could accommodate it. A modest adjustment did more for access than insisting that every neighbor prove seriousness by arriving at the facility's most convenient hour.

season_water_01_after_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_005.text: Lin left the meeting before her supported posture became painful. Qiu stayed to read the request aloud to Ren, who wanted assurance that long use had not been dismissed. The difference in departure times made Lin uneasy until she remembered that staying longer was not the selected measure of commitment. She had done the work she had agreed to do. Qiu could choose another ten minutes without making those minutes a rebuke. Rivalry would become expensive if it claimed the right to govern every ordinary departure.

season_water_01_after_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_006.text: At home, Lin found the missing path line returning to her thoughts while she washed her cup. She imagined Ma pausing before the board, Ren speaking over another neighbor, Qiu spotting a turned mark. The memories did not all belong to a single ideal method. She had chosen one approach and obtained its particular result. The coming source could improve the next action, but it would not make the earlier waiting disappear. She set the cup down and let an unfinished question remain unfinished overnight.

season_water_01_after_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_007.text: Two days later, a verified copy arrived from the ledger holder before the room opened. Su checked its covering note and the cited page against the written request. Lin did not infer that every copied word was true simply because the cover was neat; she checked that the cover identified this agreement and its later-notice search. Qiu read the route clause first. The women remained seated at a dry table with the copy supported between them, acting as readers rather than claiming custody of the original ledger.

season_water_01_after_008.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_after_008.text: The clause grants passage between two boundary stones along the canal side of the storehouse, Lin read. It names ordinary foot traffic and hand-carried goods. It allows temporary exclusion around actual repair work, with the barrier posted at the work site. She stopped at the next line. The route is described by stones, not by the new map's square. We need to identify those stones before saying which present line fulfills the clause. The agreement gave them more than a hope and less than a complete contemporary plan.

season_water_01_after_009.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_after_009.text: There is no amendment noted in the supplied search, Qiu said. That means the custodian found none in the searched record. It doesn't mean no disagreement has ever existed or that we have inspected every possible source. She looked at Ma. Still, this is a real cited passage clause, not merely our preference for a useful path. Ma leaned closer to the words, then asked which stones they meant. Her question kept the meeting practical when the women might have settled for the pleasure of finding a source that mattered.

season_water_01_after_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_010.text: Bao recognized the eastern boundary stone. The western one had once stood beside an elm that had fallen several seasons earlier. Its top might now be covered by lime from the storehouse repair. Ren said she could point to the old tree's place from the dry road. The foreman, attending by choice after his own work interval, offered to have his responsible crew brush loose material from the marked stone area. No participant entered the work enclosure or took up a tool simply to turn reading into dramatic effort.

season_water_01_after_011.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_after_011.text: The crew's ordinary authorization covers clearing its loose repair material from that existing boundary marker, Su said after the foreman showed his work list. It is not a new construction order from this meeting. The crew's maintenance funding remains separate from the reading allocation. We will observe from the cleared dry approach if the marker becomes visible. If the stone is missing or altered, we return with that fact. We do not substitute Ren's confidence or our convenient drawing for a marker we cannot actually identify.

season_water_01_after_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_012.text: The top emerged beneath a shallow coat of lime. Bao read its old cut mark and compared it with the copy's route notation while the foreman kept the actual work barrier in place. Ren pointed to the fallen elm's remembered position beyond it. The two observations agreed within the modest question they were answering. Lin wrote that agreement without enlarging it into a survey of the whole canal. Qiu sketched the two identified stones and the current enclosure on separate lines so their distinct roles could remain visible.

season_water_01_after_013.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_after_013.text: The responsible commons keeper accepted the supplied agreement and identified markers for a provisional restored display of the named foot passage. Bao remained responsible for the actual storehouse work barrier. Su posted the keeper's decision and its limits through the facility. The women did not issue the access decision themselves. The decision retained temporary repair exclusion at the actual site and reserved any broader dispute about changed ground for the responsible meeting. Ma could now point to more than an ambiguous copied square when she explained her route.

season_water_01_after_014.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_after_014.text: This does not refund any earlier climb or argument, Lin told the room. It gives the next explanation a better source. Qiu asked her to add that the source's arrival did not make the earlier selected action worthless either. Lin did so. Some useful work had occurred before the agreement appeared, according to the approach they had chosen. Some work had remained undone. The later clarification could improve the common situation while the first choice kept its real successes, omissions and timing.

season_water_01_recall.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_recall.text: Before we close this question, hear the consequence of the approach you selected. Su placed the earlier account in front of the room. The later agreement, identified stones and keeper's provisional display decision now belong to everyone present. They do not make the first afternoon identical across the possible approaches. I will name what that afternoon actually supplied and what it left someone waiting for. Then the first record can close without turning the next question into a correction of our memories.

season_water_01_open_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_open_cb_001.text: You selected the prompt limited clarification. Bao and the foreman confirmed the actual enclosure, and Ma used the dry route for one basket trip before an older copied square led a clerk to challenge her. The foreman resolved that immediate challenge. Other copied sheets and the missing agreement remained outside the first action. The later source and keeper's decision strengthen the next explanation; they do not erase either the avoided hill climb or the unnecessary waiting beside Ma's filled baskets.

season_water_01_open_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_open_cb_002.text: I want the prompt benefit and the interruption kept on separate lines, Qiu said. Lin agreed. A usable notice had mattered before the full agreement arrived, and its reach had stopped short of the copies already traveling with material lists. The room could learn from that limit without dismissing the first action as mere haste. Ma nodded at the two lines. She did not need a winner named. She needed the women to remember that one successful passage had still required her to defend it.

season_water_01_compare_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_compare_cb_001.text: You selected the source comparison. The supplied sheets, turned gate mark and installer's explanation established this copying error before the corrected display was issued. Bao and the foreman confirmed the actual barrier. Ma's first basket trip used the steep road while the comparison continued; her return used the dry path after clarification. The later agreement gives the next explanation a stronger authority. It does not reimburse the first climb or allow the complete final page to claim it arrived in time.

season_water_01_compare_cb_002.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_compare_cb_002.text: The sourced correction was useful, Lin said. Qiu's gate-mark objection found its decisive detail. The timing cost belonged to our chosen approach, and Ma should not have to admire the later source in order to have that cost recorded. Qiu asked that Lin's separation of restored notation from confirmed right remain visible too. Both contributions survived the account, along with the trip neither woman could redo for Ma. Their rivalry had supplied a sharper final record without making its slow first usefulness free.

season_water_01_listen_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_01_listen_cb_001.text: You selected listening along the dry approach. The accounts established several changed routes and a delivery confusion that Bao corrected at his actual work gate. The main board remained unsourced and misleading during that first interval, and Ma took the steep road again. The later source and keeper's decision now support a better public explanation. The listening record retains household permissions and limits. Neither its vividness nor the later correction can turn the delayed display into an action performed sooner.

season_water_01_listen_cb_002.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_listen_cb_002.text: The experiences showed what the wrong drawing was costing, Lin said. They did not repair the drawing while people continued paying that cost. Qiu agreed and asked that the narrow delivery-arrow improvement remain named. Lin added it. The chosen approach had accomplished more than collecting sorrow and less than issuing a usable general map. Ma's account stayed hers, with its agreed privacy limits. A later public-access explanation could cite the consequence without taking possession of her whole life as evidence for the women's method.

season_water_01_close_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_close_001.text: Su filed the first source question with its selected consequence and the later provisional decision. Twelve copper had been paid for season room use; the supply, witness, cleanup and return allocations remained designated for their actual later work. The older twenty-four-copper grant stayed closed. Lin took no payment and acquired no public office. Qiu took no prize. The folder held a particular access clarification, not a license for either woman to decide every future canal dispute merely because this one had rewarded careful attention.

season_water_01_close_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_01_close_002.text: The next morning, Ma used the named dry passage without stopping to seek the women. Bao's actual work barrier remained visible beside it. Lin saw the ordinary trip from the shelter and felt a satisfaction quieter than winning. It was qualified by the first afternoon's retained cost and by the limited scope of the keeper's decision. That qualification did not spoil it. A useful change could remain useful while its authors declined to make it sound permanent, universal or owed to their temperament alone.

season_water_01_close_003.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_01_close_003.text: The water mark beside the next gate has changed, Qiu said when she returned to the room for her own free interval. The keeper uses the same gauge face, but the new display's zero is painted from the repair drawing. Two people have already read opposite conditions from the two scales. She did not ask Lin to begin another trial on the spot. She brought a next ordinary question with people attached to it, and waited for Lin to decide whether this available interval was enough to hear it.

season_water_01_close_004.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_01_close_004.text: Tell me which people, Lin answered after settling her shoulder against the bench. Then show me which marks. The order surprised Qiu into a small smile. Lin had not abandoned her source preference, and Qiu had not abandoned speed. They had carried particular observations out of the first dispute. The later season would give those observations another object: water measured from two different beginnings, and a public passage whose temporary repair conditions would depend on someone explaining that difference honestly.
